test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The architect is designing a cantilevered pedestrian bridge.

options.text: A cantilevered pedestrian bridge has been designed by the architect.
A cantilevered pedestrian bridge was designed by the architect.
A cantilevered pedestrian bridge is being designed by the architect.
A cantilevered pedestrian bridge will be designed by the architect.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The architect is designing a cantilevered pedestrian bridge."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "a cantilevered pedestrian bridge" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "is designing" to "is being designed" (present continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the architect."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A cantilevered pedestrian bridge is being designed by the architect."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"A cantilevered pedestrian bridge has been designed by the architect." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"A cantilevered pedestrian bridge was designed by the architect." – Incorrect tense (past simple passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"A cantilevered pedestrian bridge will be designed by the architect." – Incorrect tense (future simple passive).
